children: Bpifrance S.A., through affiliated funds managed by Bpifrance Investissement, disclosed an 11.4% stake in Pasqal Holding SA. The group reported its position as of September 1, 2026, and filed a Schedule 13D accepted on September 3, 2026. The investment stems from Pasqal’s SPAC merger and gives Bpifrance a board seat right and added influence at the quantum computing company.

Bpifrance acquired the shares as part of the business combination that formed Pasqal Holding SA and states it holds the investment primarily for investment purposes. The filing notes, “Bpifrance Investissement has the right to designate one member of the Issuer Board of Directors,” a step that gives the investor ongoing input into governance.

While Bpifrance may buy or sell more shares over time, the immediate focus centers on board representation and support of the company following the merger. The group also holds convertible bonds and warrants tied to the deal, which could add to its stake if exercised.

Bpifrance S.A. is France’s public investment bank, jointly controlled by Caisse des Dépôts and EPIC Bpifrance, and supports companies across stages with equity and debt. Through Bpifrance Participations and Bpifrance Investissement, it invests directly and via funds in innovation-led and growth businesses. Beyond capital, Bpifrance often provides strategic support and governance input to portfolio companies.
